metadata.source_note: Minimal contract for a local-only CREATURE_ATTACKS -> MILL bridge with strict explicit wording and no parser expansion.

bridge_kind.label: creature_attacks -> mill_cards
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable strict local closure where an explicit this-creature-attacks trigger co-exists with local target-opponent/player mill payoff wording.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile.

activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit wording equivalent to 'Whenever this creature attacks, target opponent mills two cards.' or '... target player mills two cards.'
honesty_constraints: Reject 'one or more creatures attack' wording.
Reject mill text without explicit this-creature-attacks trigger.
Do not infer DRAW_CARDS -> MILL from this bridge.
